operatingAdoption.liveAndHermes: deployed; existing July holdings preserved and ledger metadata backfilled

rules.entryJumpFilter: new candidates only; exclude when signal-close return versus the stock previous trading close is >= threshold
rules.incumbentRule: keep incumbents ranked 45 or better regardless of one-day return
rules.replacementRule: scan down the fresh ranking until 15 target names are filled
rules.forwardReturnDefinition: signal close to exact close 1, 5, and 21 KOSPI trading sessions later

sOilCase.name: S-Oil
sOilCase.conclusion: The +28.45% day was not a scheduled signal, so that historical jump alone does not trigger the new-entry filter or change the modeled trade ledger.

limitations: This is a split-and-dividend total-return research cache, not the strict official corporate-action ledger.
DART coverage is held identical to the existing research engine even though the selected factor has zero EPS weight.
15% and 20% are sensitivity references; 25% is the fixed candidate and is not selected from the realized best result.
A small or event-concentrated exclusion sample cannot establish a live trading edge.
The 25% rule was later adopted as a chase-risk constraint by explicit user decision; the small sample and weaker OOS CAGR remain binding caveats.
